title: U.S. and Iran pause fighting to give peace talks 'space.' Here's where negotiations stand
summary_full: A temporary pause to the U.S.-Iran conflict appeared to hold on Monday, after negotiations over a lasting peace faced fresh hurdles over the weekend.
